تغتفرون (form VIII)
# تَغْتَفِرُونَ (taḡtafirūna) /taɣ.ta.fi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# تُغْتَفَرُونَ (tuḡtafarūna) /tuɣ.ta.fa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
